title: Welded steel bar grating 19-W-4, bearing bar 1-1/4 in x 3/16 in (1-3/16 in bar pitch, 4 in cross-bar pitch): published U row vs closed form

basis.source: F and E: header of the NAAMM MBG 531 steel load tables (S19); geometry: 19-W-4 designation (19/16 in bar pitch, 4 in cross bars); weight 8.9 psf: S20, S21
basis.note: Loads exclude the grating self-weight (S19). Simply supported single span, bearing bars parallel to the span direction.

formulas.U_psf: U = 8 F S / L^2 x 12  (L in inches; M = w L^2 / 8 with w = U/12 lb/in per ft width; M = F S)
formulas.C_lb_per_ft: C = 4 F S / L  (midspan line load across 1 ft width; M = C L / 4)
formulas.reference: elementary beam theory (Roark's Formulas for Stress and Strain, simply supported beam cases); the same formulas underlie ANSI/NAAMM MBG 534 (S19, catalogue page only)

published.note: last value of the row in the extract; the span heading was not visible, 7 ft is inferred from the closed form

pedestrianSpan.rule: max span with 100 psf uniform load and deflection <= 1/4 in (S20 'maximum pedestrian load' convention; S22)

agreement: closed form vs published U, spans 2.0/2.5/3.0/3.5/7.0 ft: within rounding to the integer psf printed (max |diff| 0.5 psf)
